basic_details.job_title: BRIC ILS Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 17 Posts
basic_details.short_information: BRIC Institute of Life Sciences (BRIC ILS) is recruiting candidates for 17 Junior Research Fellow vacancies on a contractual basis leading to a PhD program. Eligible applicants must hold an M.Sc., M.Tech., M.Pharm., M.V.Sc., or 4-year graduate program or equivalent in Life Sciences and allied subjects with at least 55%, along with a valid national competitive fellowship for five years. Fellowship and emoluments are provided as per funding agency guidelines. Candidates can apply online through the link provided in advertisement number 38/2026, paying the application fee online except for SC, ST

how_to_apply: Visit the official institute website at www.ils.res.in.
Access the online application link provided on the website under advertisement number 38/2026.
Fill out the online application form with accurate personal and educational details.
Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- online through the payment link provided in the application form, except if belonging to SC, ST, or PWD categories.
Upload required documents, including fellowship proof (admit card, result page, or certificate).
Submit the completed application online on or before 9 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the following educational and fellowship requirements to apply for the Junior Research Fellow positions: Educational Qualification: Candidates should have passed their M.Sc., M.Tech., M.Pharm., M.V.Sc., or 4-year graduate program or equivalent qualification in Life Sciences and allied subjects (Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Biophysics, Chemistry, Microbiology) with at least 55% marks without rounding off. Candidates awaiting final results may apply, but must produce their final mark sheet before joining. Fellowship Requirement: Candidates must have qualified in CSIR/UGC-JRF, DBT-JRF, UGC-RGNF, ICMR-JRF, or any other nationally competitive fellowship offered by the Government of India for PhD studies, having a valid fellowship for five years. If the original certificate is not available, a photocopy of the original admit card and the result page highlighting the roll number must be provided along with the application. Score sheet holders must submit their certificate at the time of the interview if shortlisted. Age Limit and Relaxation: Candidates should be below 28 years of age as of the last date of application submission (9 November 2026). The upper age limit is relaxed up to 5 years for SC, ST, Persons with Disability (PwD), and female applicants, and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) applicants. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BRIC ILS Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving online applications is 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the essential qualification required for these JRF positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc., M.Tech., M.Pharm., M.V.Sc., or 4-year graduate program or equivalent in Life Sciences and allied subjects with at least 55% marks, alongside a valid national competitive fellowship for five years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit and relaxation applicable for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 28 years of age as of 9 November 2026. Age relaxation is up to 5 years for SC, ST, PWD, and female applicants, and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) applicants.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants except SC, ST, and PWD are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- online.

faq.question: Q5. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: The selection involves a 3-tier procedure comprising application screening, an online first-round interview, and an offline final-round interview held at BRIC-ILS, Bhubaneswar.
